title: tbd / Ledger
description: The facts ledger: requests and latency, time inside the store and pool saturation, facts by source and their sizes, erasures and their windows, the outbox into ClickHouse and its lag, table growth, process and logs.

panels.title: Store
panels.description: The readiness probe of the store (Postgres ping, or the memory store). The gRPC health status follows it.

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Every non-ok gRPC status, contract answers included (NotFound, FailedPrecondition, InvalidArgument). The Store row separates the ledger's own failures.

panels.title: Non-ok answers/s by status
panels.description: NotFound, FailedPrecondition (erased), InvalidArgument and Aborted are the contract answering; Unavailable and Internal are the ledger failing.

panels.title: Store operation p99 by op
panels.description: Time inside the store, whoever called it: the gRPC adapter, the sweeper (execute_due_erasures, purge_idempotency) or the drainer (claim_events, ack_events). Compare with the request latency above: the gap is the adapter and the wire.

panels.title: Store failures/s by op
panels.description: unavailable: the database did not answer; internal: a bug or a broken invariant; conflict: an idempotency key reused with a different fact.

panels.title: Pool connections
panels.description: Sampled every five seconds. in_use at max means writers queue on the pool; append latency rises before anything fails.

panels.title: Time in store
panels.description: Share of request time spent in the store for the request-driven operations. Near 100 % means the database is the whole latency; well under it means the adapter, validation or the wire.

panels.title: Appends/s by source
panels.description: Facts written. Idempotent replays are not facts and are counted next door.

panels.title: Envelope bytes
panels.description: Accepted value and origin sizes. The cap is 64 KiB; a p99 near it says clients store documents, not claims.

panels.title: Facts per page
panels.description: How much a read returns. history pages grow with a subject's past; current stays at the number of live paths.

panels.title: Erasures/s
panels.description: requested opens the grace window and denies every read and write; restored cancels it inside the window; executed is the sweeper's cascade at window end.

panels.title: Erasures waiting
panels.description: pending: inside the grace window. due: past it and not yet executed; anything above zero for longer than a sweep interval means the sweeper is behind or failing.

panels.title: Cascade tombstones and purged keys/s
panels.description: A cascade writes one tombstone per surviving relation so the other side keeps a consistent history; idempotency rows are purged after their TTL.

panels.title: Outbox pending
panels.description: Events written in a transaction and not yet shipped to ClickHouse. Sampled every five seconds from Postgres.

panels.title: Oldest unpublished
panels.description: Age of the oldest event still in the outbox. Zero when it is empty. Grows when the sink is down: the ledger keeps writing, analytics falls behind, nothing is lost.

panels.title: Outbox batches/s by status
panels.description: error batches stay leased and are retried after the lease; at-least-once, the sink dedupes on event_id.

panels.title: Publish duration
panels.description: One batch handed to ClickHouse (or the recording publisher when analytics is off).

panels.title: Outbox lag
panels.description: Recorded-to-acked age of the oldest event in each batch: how far behind the ledger the analytics store is, measured on what actually shipped.

panels.title: Analytics deletes/s
panels.description: Lightweight DELETE of an erased subject's rows in ClickHouse before its erased event row is inserted, so the deletion is verifiable afterwards.

panels.title: Rows by table
panels.description: The planner's estimate (reltuples), exact after autovacuum's analyze. subjects is the population; facts grows with every append and shrinks with retractions and cascades; outbox and idempotency should stay small.

panels.title: Bytes by table
panels.description: On disk, indexes and TOAST included.

panels.title: Resident memory
panels.description: About 280 MB of this is the in-process profiler's symbol mapping (docs/observability/profiling.md); the pod limit is 512Mi.

targets.expr: _time:30m service:ledger | stats by (level) count() as lines
